label: DRT6 system
definition: A DRT system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded DefenseFinder DRT6 subtype locus represented by the DRT6__DRT6 profile.
observations: DRT6 branch under DRT system; distinct from the broader DRT system, the individual DRT6 reverse-transcriptase profile row, unresolved DRT6 phage triggers, direct RT products, host breadth, partner features, and other DRT subtypes.
